description: Helps you decide how to plan a webinar that leads to meetings, from your topic, target audience and webinar type. Optional duration, key takeaways, speakers, polls, product mention level, your product and business model shape it. Returns a run of show, a full spoken script with speaker lines and on screen cues, polls with answer options, likely questions with answers, a follow up email sequence and sector notes. It uses only what you gave and says what it did not get. Read-only for business data. It needs no sign-in and stores no inputs or outputs. Hosted usage metadata is recorded. Missing required fields or invalid values return an error naming what to supply or correct. Use this instead of thought_leadership_series when you need a live session script, polls and follow-up emails. Ask whether written customer approval covers the exact material and intended use.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge, so the advice fits it. If omitted, it is read from your text and the answer says how. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "saas".

duration.description: The webinar length. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "30_min".

include_polls.description: Include poll suggestions with answer options. Format is true or false. For example, true.

key_takeaways.description: Optional: what attendees should learn, one per line, per semicolon or comma-separated. If not provided, takeaways are suggested from the topic. Format is text. For example, "exception queue and approval history".

product_mention_level.description: Whether to add product tie-in placeholders to the script ('none' leaves them out). Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "none".

publication_approval.description: Optional confirmed written approval for this exact customer name, figures, quote and intended use. Ask before publication. A draft cannot grant customer permission. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "approved".

speakers.description: Optional: speakers as you want them listed. Separate speakers with semicolons or line breaks ('Name, Title; Name, Title'), or with commas if each is one phrase. Format is text. For example, "procurement lead and security reviewer".

target_audience.description: Who will attend (for example 'Support leaders at consumer apps'). Format is text.

topic.description: The webinar topic or title. Format is text. For example, "Reducing invoice approval delays".

webinar_type.description: The kind of webinar; sets the structure. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "educational".

your_product.description: Optional: your product or service name, used in the answer. Without it the answer says so and shows a placeholder. Format is text. For example, "invoice review service".

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear. Format is text using one of the listed labels. For example, "logistics_tech".

name: webinar_script
title: Webinar Script
